verdict.rationale: Poly is a cloud storage service rather than a local-first store. It does keep notes in readable formats: journal entries are Markdown files synced to the Mind folder (poly-docs-12), and files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer (poly-docs-23). However, those files download on demand and sync back to Poly's storage, and processing happens on a remote server (poly-comm-4), so local ownership is only partial and offline operation is never documented. Missing for 10: documented offline operation, a local-first source of truth (as opposed to cloud files downloaded on demand), offline availability of search and the agent, and independent confirmation that notes stay readable without the app.
